Resume Builder

Type your details once and get a clean, professional resume preview. Print it or save it as a PDF straight from your browser — no sign-up needed.

Use your browser's Print → Save as PDF. Only the resume prints — the form is hidden.

📖 How to use

  1. Fill in your contact details and summary.
  2. Add experience lines, education and skills.
  3. Watch the resume preview update live.
  4. Use Print / Save as PDF to export your resume.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I save my resume as a PDF?

Fill in the form fields and the preview updates live. Then click Print / Save as PDF and choose "Save as PDF" in your browser's print dialog.

Is my personal data uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything stays in your browser on your own device. Nothing is uploaded or stored anywhere.

Can I add multiple jobs or degrees?

The builder keeps one entry per line, so list each role, degree or certificate on its own line in the right order.
